description: Verify a presented OpenTrain talent credential — an Open Badges 3.0 VC-JWT (Ed25519) issued for a contributor's quality-gated standing or outcome medal on the open contribution tier. Checks the signature, issuer, and live revocation state; returns the credential's measured results (accepted units, gold accuracy, medals). No scope needed — credentials are public verifiable objects.

credentialJwt.description: The presented OpenTrain talent credential (compact VC-JWT).

name: opentrain_verify_talent_credential
